en: The Mahāmegha Sūtra.
Oṃ! Homage to all the inconceivable oceans of Buddhas and Bodhisattvas.
Thus have I heard: at one time the Blessed One was dwelling in the abode of the Naga kings Nanda and Upananda.

In the peaked palace of the great cloud-circle containing the essence of precious jewels, he was together with a great community of monks, a great community of bodhisattvas, and a great host of nāga kings,
such as the nāga king Nanda, Upananda, Sāgara, Anavatapta, Manasvin, Varuṇa, Takṣaka, Dhṛtarāṣṭra, Vāsuki, and Mucilinda.
And [there were] Erāvaṇa, Pauṇḍra, Śrītejas, Śrībhadra, Vidyumālin, Mahāmaṇicūḍa, Cūḍāmaṇidhara, Avabhāsanaśikhi, Indrāyudhaśikhara,
Indradhvaja, Indrayaṣṭi, Jambudhvaja, Svastika, Mahāmaṇḍalika, Mahābhujaṅga, Jyotirasas, Śaśitejas, and Śrīmat.
And [there were] Soma-darśana, Sudarśana, Supratiṣṭhita, Maṇikaṇṭha, Meghasambhava, Varṣadhāra, Prasphoṭaka, Visphoṭaka, Visphūrjita,
Mahāphaṇaka, Gambhīranirghoṣa, Mahānirnādanādin, Nāgarāja, Vinardita, Utpalaka, and Mahāvikrama.
And with the Naga kings Īṣādhāra, Citrasena, Mahāpāśa, Elapatra, Ābhāsa, Kharakarṇa, Śaṅkha, Dardara,
Upadardara, Kṣemaṃkara, Mahākṣemaṃkara, Bhujaṃgama, Mahābhujaṃgama, Mahābala, Phaluḍa, Apalāla, Lambura, and Kṛmiśa.
And by the nāga kings Kṛṣṇa and Indrasena, Naḍa and Upanaḍa, Kambudhāra, Dramida, Sundara, Hastikarṇa, Tīkṣṇaka, Piṅgala,
Vidyujjvāla, Mahāvidyutprabha, Baladeva, Kambala, Bharukaccha, Amṛta, Tīrthaka, and Vaiḍūryaprabha.
And with Suvarṇakeśa, Kanakaprabha, Śaśiketuprabha, Sūryaprabha, Udayana, Gaveśīrṣa, Śvetaka, the Nāga king Kālaka,
Yama, Śrāmaṇa, Masaka, Saṃhatana, Nimiṃdhara, Dharaṇīṃdhara, Sahasraśīrṣa, Maṇicūḍa, and Amoghadarśana.
And with the nāga kings Balāhaka, Suṣeṇa, Gopāla, Naradatta, Vinīta, Jarāyaṇa, Kumbhīra, Kumbhīramukha,
Viṣaṃdhara, Āśiviṣa, Padmaka, Lāṅgula, Pralamba, Bhīṣaṇa, Sutejas, Pañcaśīrṣa, Ballira, and Jaradratha.
And with the nāga king Uttaraka, Dīrghapuccha, Sphāraśīrṣa, Bimbika, Vidhura, Aśvaka, Triśīrṣa, Nāgaṣeṇa, Mahātejas,
Naladatta, Bhīmaka, Dīptaprabha, Saptaśīrṣa, Bṛhadruma, Priyadarśana, Mahāpracaṇḍa, Vimalatejas, and Sunetra.
And with Mahāghora, Arciḥskandha, Mahācaṇḍa, Ugrakrodha, Ratnāmbuda, Mahāmeghāmbuda, Indraprabha, Pādapena, Meghacandra, Sāgaramegha,
Mahāgandhakusuma, Kumudākara, Ratnanetre, Nāgarāja, Mahāketudhvaja, and Mahāmeghagarbha.
And with Himavat, Śrīgarbha, Meghaśaktika, Rajanindhara, Ambuda, Mahāmeghāmbuda, Mahāmbuda, Vaiśvānaratejas,
Megheśvararāja, Vigatakrodha, Kakuba, Nāgaśūra, Jalandhara, Meghacchatra, Iṅgīramukha, Tejasvin, Meghasphūḍita, and Anantakrama.
And with the nāga kings Suṣeṇa, Mahāśarīra, Vṛkodara, Śānti, Vīra, Kākanāda, Uddhura, Viṣogra, Sughoṣa, Amṛtasāra,
Mahāpravarṣaka, Vidyunnada, Saṃghaṭṭaśabda, Dundubhisvara, Amṛtadhāra, Nandika,
Garjasphoṭaka, Sūrasena, Nārāyaṇa, Vadavāmukha, and Vikaṭa.
Thus, with these as their leaders and preceded by all the great Nāga kings, eight million four hundred thousand billion Nāgas had assembled and were seated.
Then, at that time, all those Nāga kings together with their retinues rose from their seats, draped their upper robes over one shoulder, and placed their right knees upon the ground.

Bowing with palms joined toward where the Blessed One was, they made a great roar, thundering and rattling, sending forth great winds and uttering a great sound, while sounding the delightful sounds of the Dharma; [they did so] with immeasurable and incalculable, most various and beautiful flowers, incense, perfumes, garlands, ointments, powders, robes, parasols, banners, flags, silk streamers, wreaths, musical instruments, cymbals, drums, and orchestral performances; with jeweled flowers, jeweled wreaths, pearl necklaces, *nāgapuṣpa* flowers, and nets of pearls.
Covering the Blessed One with great reverence, honor, and wonder, they circumambulated him.
Having circumambulated him, they stood to one side;
standing to one side, they made their aspirations.
With oceans of bodies as numerous as the atoms in all the oceans of world-systems,
[I appear] within all the oceans of assemblies of Buddhas and Bodhisattvas,
and within all the oceans of the expansions of world-systems.
In all the atoms of earth, water, fire, and wind, and in all the atoms of light that correspond to all forms—
within each and every single atom—
With ocean-like clouds of bodies that have transcended all calculation— transcending the incalculable, the immeasurable, the inconceivable, the incomparable, the unattainable, and the ineffable—
and having empowered within each single body immeasurable and incalculable oceans of clouds of hands,

[they offered] from every single atom-dust particle facing the currents of the universal directions, with undifferentiated expansions throughout all directions of the world-systems, oceans of clouds of every kind of offering.
We shall honor, revere, respect, and worship the oceans of all Buddhas and Bodhisattvas—

that is to say, those who are immeasurable, incalculable, inconceivable, incomparable, unfathomable, and infinite— by means of clouds of oceans of majestic power that are ineffable, indivisible, and that pervade the expanse of space, covering it with the conduct of Samantabhadra.

Just as with oceans and clouds of the physical bodies of Bodhisattvas, so too with oceans and clouds of all jewel-colored light-rays and wealth, oceans and clouds of the orb of physical bodies of all suns and moons, and oceans and clouds of all jewel necklaces and flowers.
with clouds of oceans of gabled palaces containing the luster of all jewels;
with clouds of oceans of treasuries of trees of all powdered incenses; with clouds of oceans of manifestations of all forms through all fragrances and incenses;
and with clouds of oceans of musical instruments resounding with all vocal melodies.
Having pervaded the expanse of the sky with clouds of oceans of treasuries of all kinds of fragrant trees,
and with these as the foremost among immeasurable, incalculable, inconceivable, incomparable, unmeasurable, infinite, and ineffable, undifferentiated oceans of clouds of every kind of offering—
We shall honor, revere, respect, and worship the oceans of all Buddhas and Bodhisattvas;
having empowered the expanse of space so that it is completely covered by clouds of oceans of king-jewels whose interiors are illuminated by the sphere of all arrays,
we shall honor, revere, respect, and worship the oceans of all Buddhas and Bodhisattvas.

with ocean-clouds of jewel-kings, arrays of rains of jewels illuminating all directions; with ocean-clouds of jewel-kings, resounding with the Buddha’s definitive roar and flaming with rays of all jewels;

with ocean-clouds of jewel-kings, resonating with the sound of all Buddha-dharmas pervading everywhere; with ocean-clouds of jewel-kings, manifesting the illumination of Buddha-emanations through jewel-rays from every direction.

With ocean-clouds of king-jewels that manifest the reflections of all unconfused circles of assemblies; with ocean-clouds of king-jewels that follow after the spheres of all Buddhas like lamps of radiance;
with ocean-clouds of king-jewels that manifest the reflections of the inconceivable Buddha-fields and the celestial palaces of the Tathāgatas.

Having empowered the expanse of space so that it is completely covered by ocean-like clouds of Vairocana-jewel-kings, which consist of the dust of all various jewels and reflect the bodies of the Buddhas of the three times,
may we honor, revere, respect, and worship the oceans of all Buddhas and Bodhisattvas.

With ocean-clouds of gabled palaces variegated with all kinds of jewels, perfumes, and flowers, unmixed; with ocean-clouds of gabled palaces adorned with all kinds of king-of-jewels of infinite colors;
and with ocean-clouds of gabled palaces whose fragrance-flames are lamps made of every kind of jewel.
with ocean-clouds of gabled palaces variegated with all kinds of pearl necklaces;
with ocean-clouds of all kinds of flower filaments;
and with ocean-clouds of gabled palaces adorned with infinite jewel necklaces.
Having pervaded the expanse of the sky,

[he was covered] by ocean-like clouds of peaked palaces that radiate everywhere, whose interiors are filled with the light of rays pervading the ten directions, and which are adorned with every kind of array;
and by ocean-like clouds of peaked palaces that manifest many arrays adorned with dust motes of every jewel.

Having empowered the surface of the sky so that it was completely covered by ocean-like clouds of gabled pavilions spreading everywhere, adorned with every kind of array, and by ocean-like clouds of flowered archways with hanging nets of bells from all directions;

We shall honor, revere, respect, and worship the oceans of all Buddhas and Bodhisattvas with clouds of oceans of lion-thrones filled with the essence of joy, made of various threads and necklaces of gold and jewels; and with clouds of oceans of lion-thrones filled with the essence of various radiant flowers.
with ocean-clouds of lion-thrones whose interiors are variegated with sapphire, jambunada gold, and lotuses;

with ocean-clouds of lion-thrones whose interiors are filled with lamps, jewels, and lotuses; with ocean-clouds of lion-thrones whose interiors are variegated with luminous banners, precious gems, and lotuses.
with ocean-clouds of lion thrones with variegated interiors of lotuses adorned with jewels;
with ocean-clouds of lion thrones with lotus-interiors blazing with radiant rays of sapphire;
with ocean-clouds of lion thrones with lotus-interiors possessing the brilliance of blazing inexhaustible rays;

Having empowered the expanse of the sky so that it was completely covered by oceans of clouds of lion-thrones with lotus-calices issuing from the flames of all jewels, and by oceans of clouds of lion-thrones with lotus-calices [emerging from] light-rays of the resonant roar of the Buddha’s voice, which were unconfused and distinct;
We shall honor, revere, respect, and worship the oceans of all Buddhas and Bodhisattvas with clouds of oceans of various trees made of all kinds of fragrances and jewels,
and with clouds of fragrance-trees emerging from clouds of hands joined in reverent salutation at the universal gates.

With ocean-clouds of trees manifesting infinite arrays in the forms of all trees; with ocean-clouds of trees from which hang clouds of every kind of flower; with ocean-clouds of trees emitting endless treasuries from their arrays of every tree.
With clouds of oceans of trees illuminated by the light of mandalas of all-jewel rays;
with clouds of oceans of bodhisattvas displaying half-bodies amidst clouds of all sandalwood powder;

and with clouds of oceans of trees illuminated by the sun from infinite treasuries of all-jewel garments belonging to the tree-deities of the inconceivable arrays of light at all seats of enlightenment (*bodhimaṇḍala*).
with ocean-clouds of trees emitting everywhere delightful sounds that resonate with all vocal expressions;
with ocean-clouds of lion thrones whose interior is filled with jewel-lotuses of infinite colors;
with ocean-clouds of lion thrones whose interior is illuminated by the sovereign mani-jewels facing in all directions.

with ocean-clouds of lion-thrones whose interiors are adorned with the arrays of all ornaments; with ocean-clouds of lion-thrones whose interiors are garlands of lamps consisting of the radiant flames of various jewels;
with ocean-clouds of lion-thrones from whose interiors there issues a rain of jewels with a universal resonance.

With ocean-clouds of lion-thrones containing the essence of all fragrances, flowers, lotuses, necklaces, and jewels; with ocean-clouds of lion-thrones containing the essence of the king of jewels that manifest the arrays of all Buddha-seats;
and with ocean-clouds of lion-thrones containing the essence of jewels adorned with all manner of arrays, hanging necklaces, archways, and railings.

Having empowered the expanse of the sky so that it was completely covered by oceans of clouds of lion-thrones whose interiors were filled with the powder of the branches of all trees made of mani-jewels, and by oceans of clouds of lion-thrones whose interiors were illuminated like the sun by a universal adornment of networks of bells made of various fragrant jewels;
We shall honor, revere, respect, and worship the oceans of all Buddhas and Bodhisattvas with clouds of canopies of all *cintāmaṇi* jewel-kings,
and with clouds of canopies of arrays of all flowers with *indranīla* gems for their filaments.
with ocean-clouds of canopies made of all kinds of fragrant jewels;
with ocean-clouds of canopies in the form of lamps of jewel-rays;
with ocean-clouds of canopies of sovereign jewels that emit the sound of the radiance manifesting the supernatural powers of the Buddhas;
With ocean-clouds of canopies manifesting the radiance of all arrays of variegated jewels and garments;
with ocean-clouds of jewel canopies emitting the blazing light of floods of every kind of flower;
and with ocean-clouds of flaming canopies pervaded by the universal resonance of various bells.
with ocean-clouds of canopies consisting of lotus-nets with variegated jewel-bases, possessing the blazing radiance of lotuses of infinite colors;
with ocean-clouds of canopies consisting of banners of light from the rays of golden filaments;
with ocean-clouds of canopies consisting of all manner of ornamental arrays, manifesting inconceivable manifestations of splendor.
Having taken our stand, pervading the entire expanse of space,
we shall honor, revere, respect, and worship the oceans and clouds of all the Buddhas and Bodhisattvas with oceans and clouds of various canopies made of every kind of jewel and gem.
Having pervaded the expanse of the sky,
[he was covered] by oceans of clouds of flower-parasols arrayed with the light of ten jewel-rays,
and by oceans of clouds of parasols that are treasuries of liberation in infinite colors.
With ocean-clouds of jewel-king parasols emitting the sounds from the mouths of the compassion of all Buddhas and Bodhisattvas;
with ocean-clouds of parasols adorned with garlands of various jewel-flames;
with ocean-clouds of parasols hung with networks of bells adorned by the radiance of universal jewel-dust.
with ocean-clouds of parasols adorned with all kinds of jewel-trees and branches;

with ocean-clouds of parasols made of the king of jewels that radiates light like the sun and filled with all kinds of fragrant incense; with ocean-clouds of parasols that emit sandalwood powder from their interiors in all directions;

With ocean-clouds of parasols that pervade all universal arrays, illuminated by the vast domain of the Buddhas, may we honor, revere, respect, and worship the oceans of all Buddhas and Bodhisattvas without distinction;
with ocean-clouds of mandalas of light from all jewels.
With unconfused clouds of oceans of light-orbs from the bodies of all jewels;
with clouds of oceans of light-orbs illuminated by clouds of flowers;
with clouds of oceans of light-orbs from the emanations of Buddhas through the rays of all jewels.

With ocean-clouds of circles of light appearing within all Buddha-fields; with ocean-clouds of circles of light from jewel-branches resounding with the range of the Buddhas' spheres through all their gateways;
and with ocean-clouds of rays of light from the king of jewels of the lineage of all vaidūrya gems.
With ocean-clouds of circles of light manifesting the forms, minds, and moments of infinite sentient beings;
with ocean-clouds of circles of light emitting delightful sounds arising from the vows of all Buddhas;
with ocean-clouds of circles of light from the king of jewels, the resonance that disciplines the sentient beings within all circles of assemblies.
We shall honor, revere, respect, and worship the oceans of all Buddhas and Bodhisattvas with clouds of oceans of rays from all jewel-treasuries,
and with clouds of oceans of rays of all Buddha-forms, sounds, fragrances, tastes, and textures.
With clouds of oceans of light-rays of all jewels;
with clouds of oceans of light-rays that pervade and resound with the teachings of all Buddhas;
with clouds of oceans of light-rays illuminated by the arrays of all Buddha-fields.
with clouds of oceans of light-rays from all flower-pagodas; with clouds of oceans of light-rays from all jewel-dust;
with clouds of oceans of light-rays that roar forth the arising of Buddhas and the ripening of sentient beings throughout the succession of all eons;
With clouds of oceans of light-rays from the filaments of all flowers that manifest the jewel of inexhaustible beings;

with clouds of oceans of light-rays that display the array of all thrones; and with unadulterated clouds of oceans of jewel-flames of infinite colors, may we honor, revere, respect, and worship the oceans of all Buddhas and Bodhisattvas.
With ocean-clouds of light-rays from the king of jewels of universal radiance;
with ocean-clouds of light-rays illuminated by the arrays of all vast buddha-fields; with ocean-clouds of light-rays of all fragrances;
with clouds of oceans of rays from all arrays, with clouds of oceans of rays from the emanations of all Buddhas,
and with clouds of oceans of rays from the filaments of various jewel-trees;
With clouds of oceans of light from all kinds of garments;
with clouds of oceans of light from jewel-kings whose resonance is the infinite conduct of bodhisattvas; with clouds of oceans of light from lamps made of all kinds of pearls.

With these undifferentiated clouds and oceans of all kinds of fragrant flowers and diverse jewel-lotus nets, we shall honor, revere, respect, and worship the oceans of clouds of all Buddhas and Bodhisattvas.
With inconceivable oceans and clouds of all fragrant flowers and various jewels,
and with oceans and clouds of radiant jewel-lotus nets;
with clouds of oceans of mandalas of light from infinite-colored mani-jewels;
with clouds of oceans of pearl-treasures of every jewel-color;
with clouds of oceans of powdered sandalwood incense of every kind of jewel;
With clouds and oceans of canopies made of all kinds of jewels;
with clouds and oceans of celestial pavilions that are banners of light, possessing golden filaments and rays of splendor, emitting delightful and auspicious sounds;
and with clouds and oceans of all manner of ornamental arrays, manifesting inconceivable manifestations of exquisite arrangements.
with ocean-clouds of king-of-jewels whose sounds are pleasing, auspicious, and beautiful;
with ocean-clouds of necklaces of sun-light jewel-wheels;
with ocean-clouds of infinite treasuries of jewels;
With ocean-clouds of physical forms, which are the essence of universal sameness and auspiciousness,
and which are indivisible, we shall honor, revere, respect, and worship the oceans of clouds of all the Buddhas and Bodhisattvas.
Having made such a vow, those Naga kings again circumambulated the Blessed One three times and prostrated at his feet.

Permitted by the Blessed One, they sat down each upon their own seats. Now at that time, Anantaparikarṣasāgarameghavyūhatejomaṇḍalacchatrākārarāja, the great lord of nāgas of the triple-thousand great-thousandfold world system, having come to Jambudvīpa through the cultivation of irreversible vows, was present for the sake of honoring, saluting, attending upon, and hearing the Dharma from the Tathāgata.

Then indeed, the great lord of nāgas, King Anantaparikarasāgarameghavyūhatejomaṇḍalacchatrākāra, who rules over the triple-thousand great thousandfold world system, rose from his seat, draped his upper robe over one shoulder,
placed his right knee upon the ground, and bowing with palms joined toward the Blessed One, addressed the Blessed One as follows:

"I would ask the Blessed One, the Tathāgata, the Arhat, the Samyaksambuddha, a certain question regarding a specific point, if the Blessed One would grant me the opportunity to answer the question when asked.
When this was said, the Blessed One spoke thus to the Naga king Anantaparikarasāgarameghavyūhatejomaṇḍalachatrākārarāja:
"Ask, O Lord of Serpents, whatever you desire; I shall [answer] for you."
"I shall satisfy the minds of each and every one of them by answering their questions.

When this had been said, the Great Lord of Nāgas, named Anantaparikarasāgarameghavyūhatejomaṇḍalacchatrākārarāja, who rules over the triple-thousand great thousandfold world system, addressed the Blessed One:
"Blessed One, how might all the sufferings of all the nāgas be completely stilled?"
Rejoicing and endowed with happiness, they would release showers of rain here in Jambudvīpa at the proper times,
causing all grasses, shrubs, medicinal herbs, and forest trees to sprout, and bringing forth all crops.
"May they produce all flavors, by which the humans of Jambudvīpa may become endowed with happiness.
When this was said, the Blessed One spoke thus to Anantaparikarasāgarameghavyūhatejomaṇḍalacchatrākārarāja, the great lord of nāgas of the trichiliocosm:

"Excellent, excellent, O Lord of Serpents! It is well that you have set out for the benefit and happiness of all sentient beings, and that you consider it necessary to question the Tathāgata on this matter. Therefore, O Lord of Serpents, listen and pay close and careful attention; I shall speak to you.
By means of a single dharma, O Lord of Serpents, all the sufferings of all nāgas who are endowed with it shall be completely stilled."
And may they be established in happiness.
By what single dharma?
Namely, by loving-kindness (*maitrī*). In that regard, O Lord of Serpents, gods and humans who dwell in loving-kindness—
They are not burned by fire, they are not wounded by weapons, and they are not carried away by water.
They are not killed by poison,
they are not overcome by the armies of enemies,
and they sleep in peace.
They awaken in happiness,
they become protected by their own merit,
and they are invigorated by the splendor of great merit.
They become invincible;
they become pleasing to the world including the gods;
they become lovely to behold; and they become everywhere unimpeded in their movement.
They become completely relieved of all suffering and are filled with great joy;
endowed with every happiness, they realize the higher human qualities and, upon the dissolution of the body, are reborn in the Brahma-world.
These, O Lord of Serpents, are the benefits for gods and humans who dwell in loving-kindness.
Therefore, O Lord of Serpents, one should dwell with loving-kindness in bodily action, loving-kindness in verbal action, and loving-kindness in mental action.
Furthermore, O Lord of Serpents, the dhāraṇī named "Bestower of All Happiness" should be set in motion;
it pacifies all the sufferings of all nāgas and bestows all happiness.

O Lord of Serpents, what is that dhāraṇī named "Bestower of All Happiness" by which it releases showers of rain from time to time here in Jambudvīpa, causing all grasses, shrubs, medicinal herbs, trees, and crops to grow?
Namely: dhāraṇi dhāraṇi, uttāraṇi, saṃpratiṣṭhitā, vijayavarṇā, satyapratijñā, sahājñānavatī, utpādani, vināśani, abhiṣecani, abhivyāhāraśubhāvati, ajīmatāmahi, kumbālanivāhā;
remove the afflictions!
Shake off evil, purify the paths;
this is the nature of phenomena, free from effort.
Pure light,
free from darkness and dust,
the pacifier of suffering.
Blessed by the gaze of all Buddhas, O Prajñā of the Sahā world, O Radiance of Gnosis, svāhā!

O Lord of Serpents, these dhāraṇī mantra-words should be maintained and recited; they are the means for accomplishing all things, the gateways for entering the Dharma, empowered by all Buddhas, and bestowers of all happiness.
